concerns.text: Task T040 mandates updating `spec.md` (the Single Source of Truth) to add a 'Computational Error Bounds' assumption. This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and Principle V (Versioning Discipline) by modifying the source specification *after* tasks have been generated against it. The spec must remain static during the task phase; methodological clarifications should be added to `research.md` or a new 'Methodological Note' artifact, not by editing the spec that defines the requirements.

Tasks T018a2 and T018c2 require halting execution (`sys.exit(1)`) upon split failure but fail to implement the Spec's Edge Case requirement to 'output a report stating that statistical comparison is invalid'. The tasks only log to an error file, leaving the downstream report generation (T029a3) without the required artifact to document the failure mode, thus weakening the acceptance criteria for the 'Insufficient Structural Diversity' edge case.

Task T025c implements SC-003 by summing Gini importance for Morgan bits within radius 2 of the phosphorus atom but fails to define the equivalent subset for MACCS keys. SC-003 requires comparing Morgan bits 'surrounding the phosphorus center' against 'MACCS keys'. Since MACCS keys are global structural keys without a defined 'radius' or 'center', the task's instruction to 'sum for MACCS keys' is mathematically ambiguous (sum of all bits? a subset?). This creates a semantic weakening of SC-003, as the comparison metric is undefined for one of the two models.

Tasks T020a and T020b describe training/evaluating a 'Final Model' on the 'Single Held-Out Test Set' but do not specify if this model is re-trained on the *entire* filtered dataset (using split indices only for evaluation) or trained solely on the split training set. SC-003 (T025c) requires a model trained on the *full data* to derive meaningful feature importances. This ambiguity risks producing a model artifact (`final_models.pkl`) that does not satisfy the data scope required by SC-003, weakening the success criterion.
